fields.description: Defaults applied when a Shift Type does not specify its own policy. Override per Shift Type as needed.
fields.label: Penalty Policies

fields.description: Default policy used when an employee exceeds their grace pool.
fields.label: Attendance Penalty Policy

fields.description: Default policy used for unpermitted absences.
fields.label: Absence Penalty Policy

fields.description: Controls how Attendance Pre-Authorizations are created, expired and penalized when consumed minutes exceed the approved amount.
fields.label: Pre-Authorization

fields.description: Policy used to penalize the minutes that exceed an employee's Approved Attendance Pre-Authorization. Only Factor and Fixed Per Hour policies are valid.
fields.label: Surplus Policy

fields.description: When checked, newly created Pre-Authorizations skip HR review and are immediately Approved. Use this when HR is the only role creating pre-authorizations.
fields.label: Auto-Approve Pre-Authorizations

fields.description: Number of days after a pre-authorization's date before unconsumed records (Draft / Pending Approval / Approved) are auto-marked Expired by the daily scheduler. An Approved pre-auth is expired only if it was never consumed by a submitted Attendance — this prevents stale approvals from being absorbed by a late-arriving attendance amendment.
fields.label: Expiry (Days)

fields.description: Inputs for converting penalty minutes into a deduction amount. Used by the Factor penalty type and the daily-rate basis for the Penalty Matrix.
fields.label: Salary Calculation

fields.description: Salary Component used for the resulting deduction. Override per Shift Type if needed.
fields.label: Salary Component

fields.description: Working days per month used to derive the daily rate from base salary (daily_rate = base / month_days). Common values: 22 (working days), 26 (six-day week), 30 (calendar days).
fields.label: Month Days

fields.description: Base: daily_rate = base / month_days. Total: daily_rate = (base + variable) / month_days.
fields.label: Salary Basis

fields.description: Toggles that govern downstream document creation after an Attendance is submitted.
fields.label: Automation

fields.description: If checked, Discipline Penalties are created as auto-processed; otherwise they are pending review.
fields.label: Auto-Process Discipline Penalty

fields.description: If unchecked, the Additional Salary is created as a Draft and must be submitted manually.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Additional Salary
